gaps.summary: Booker-cancelled unpaid request renders host-decline copy ('Declined' / 'The host couldn't take your booking'). Row: status=declined, cancelled_by=booker. Detail page declined branch + deriveBookingStatusView ignore cancelled_by.
/host/bookings list rows have no link to /host/bookings/[id]; host cancel flow (SC#3) unreachable without hand-typing a UUID. host-booking-row.tsx has no href.
Checkout policy SUMMARY line advertises an already-lapsed top refund rung ('Free cancellation until <past instant>') without comparing the boundary to now.

placeHold re-emits the request-received + new-request-to-host notification pair on an idempotent replay (double-click), unlike re-request.ts which suppresses. Duplicate host notifications/emails on double-submit.
formatMoney drops the trailing zero: '₱307.5' instead of '₱307.50' (also refundLabel payload).
Copy nits: '₱300in' missing space on /host/earnings; raw enum 'host_cancellation' shown as block label on the availability page.

No UI links to /host/listings/[id]/availability (weekly-hours editor); wizard has no hours step and publish checklist doesn't require hours, so a published listing can sit at 'No availability yet'. Pre-existing Phase 3/4 discoverability gap surfaced during Phase-7 UAT.
